text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while Nishino Flower was reading
a fan letter she had received...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm just...
a little touched by the letter I received.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"The person who wrote this fan letter
mentioned their grandchild is around the same age as me—"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...'I was living a lonely life on my own,
but seeing Nishino Flower run always gives me so much energy.'"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"My grandchild loves Nishino Flower-san too,
and whenever we meet, the two of us
always talk about Nishino Flower-san."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“To us, Nishino Flower-san is...”
“...someone who brings us smiles...”
“...like a warm sun.”...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Next time"... "I will bring my grandchild
to the racetrack to cheer you on."... it says—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
For this person and her grandchild's sake as well...
I'll do my best! And then—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to make people smile even more!
